content:
q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

The file `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` contains all memo CRUD mutations and queries — `useCreateMemo()`, `useUpdateMemo()`, `useDeleteMemo()`, `useMemo()`, `useMemos()`, `useInfiniteMemos()`, plus comment-related queries. It imports `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect` (`web/src/connect.ts:197`), which is created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` where `MemoService` is the generated Connect-RPC service descriptor from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
